title: Associate Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA-Tencor Corporation (NASDAQ: KLAC), a leading provider of process control and yield management solutions, partners with customers around the world to develop state-of-the-art inspection and metrology technologies. These technologies serve the semiconductor, data storage, LED, photovoltaic, and other related nanoelectronics industries. With a portfolio of industry-standard products and a team of world-class engineers and scientists, the company has created superior solutions for its customers for over 30 years. Headquartered in Milpitas, California, KLA-Tencor has dedicated customer operations and service centers around the world. Additional information may be found at www.kla-tencor.com Software Engineer Essential

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work closely with cross-functional teams to implement project goals, requirements, and in given timelines. Develop SW to deploy various components of the software across various nodes and manages multiple side by side instances of the SW. Keep abreast of the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices. Contribute to existing documentation or knowledge base that expedites resolution time of queries from stakeholders like quality team, customer support, global service team, etc., Triage SW issues and track them and debug to identify the root causes of issues, resolve with fast turnaround time
- Creating impact on overall system, and quality. Proactively identify and mitigate technical challenges and risks. Conduct thorough code reviews and provide actionable feedback. Minimum Qualifications Qualifications/Requirements: MS/MTech degree in Computer Science/SW Engg/Electronics/Electrical Engg/Mechanical/Aerospace Engg disciplines. Strong object-oriented programming skills in C#/Java/Python Knowledge in Inter-Process Communication (IPC) techniques and tools viz: g RPC, REST, Graph QL protobuf, JSON, etc., Work experience in frontend technologies like angular, react is an added advantage. Experience with container orchestration and management tools
- Dockers, K8's, Helm Charts, etc., [Desirable] Experience in database management system, including SQL Database: SQL Server, SQLite No SQL Databases: Mongo DB Time Series Databases: Prometheous, Influx DB Familiarity with observability tools and practices
- Opentelemetry, Grafana, Elastic, Kibana, Logstash, etc., Proficiency in scripting languages like shell and ansible for automation solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Our primary areas of strategic focus include talent acquisition, individual and organizational assessment and development, performance management, inclusion and engagement, and rewards. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Talent Acquisition Sourcer to join our global Talent Acquisition team in Chennai, India. Work schedule for this exciting role will be a swing shift position, work hours will be 3:30pm
- 12:30am IST. In this role, you will partner closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, and Talent Acquisition leaders to identify, engage, and build pipelines of qualified candidates for technical, engineering, and business-critical U.S. positions. You will leverage market intelligence, sourcing technologies, and proactive outreach strategies to build highly qualified talent pipelines and support hiring initiatives across multiple U.S. and Global business functions. Talent Identification Conduct proactive sourcing activities to identify qualified passive and active candidates for current and future hiring needs. Utilize advanced sourcing techniques, including internet research, talent mapping, publication searches, patent searches, social networking platforms, and professional communities. Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies aligned with business hiring priorities. Build talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill positions across multiple geographies and disciplines. Candidate Engagement Initiate and manage candidate outreach campaigns through Linked In, email, professional networking platforms, and other sourcing channels. Build and maintain relationships with prospective candidates to support current and future hiring needs. Qualify candidate interest, experience, and alignment with position requirements prior to recruiter engagement. Deliver a positive and professional candidate experience throughout sourcing interactions. Pipeline Management Build, maintain, and regularly update candidate pipelines for assigned requisitions. Track sourcing activity, pipeline health, candidate engagement metrics, and recruiting outcomes. Present qualified candidate slates to recruiting partners within agreed service-level expectations. Maintain accurate candidate data and activity records within recruiting systems and talent communities. Partnership & Collaboration Collaborate closely with Recruiters during intake meetings to understand position requirements, market availability, and sourcing strategies. Partner with Hiring Managers and recruiting stakeholders to align sourcing efforts with workforce planning objectives. Support sourcing projects and talent building initiatives. Support strategic pipeline development initiatives as needed. Technology & Process Excellence Utilize sourcing and recruiting platforms including Linked In, Hire EZ, Workday, Hired Score, and other talent intelligence tools. Manage candidate pools, campaigns, and talent communities within sourcing platforms. Identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness and candidate engagement strategies. Stay current on emerging sourcing technologies and industry best practices. Leverage AI-powered recruiting technologies, including talent intelligence platforms, candidate relationship management systems, sourcing automation tools, and generative AI solutions to identify talent, conduct market research, improve outreach effectiveness, and build strategic talent pipelines at scale. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, Engineering, or related field. 2+ years of experience supporting talent acquisition initiatives for engineering and technical positions, including candidate sourcing, talent mapping, pipeline development, and candidate engagement. Experience sourcing for engineering, software, semiconductor, manufacturing, or other technical positions. Proficiency with Linked In Recruiter, Workday, and AI powered sourcing recruitment tools. Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships with recruiters, hiring managers and stakeholders. Experience identifying and engaging passive candidates through direct sourcing methodologies. jobDescription: Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Required Skills & Experience ▪ 4–5 years of experience in Dev Sec Ops, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in a lead or senior technical role. ▪ Proven experience leading and mentoring security or Dev Ops engineering teams. ▪ Expert-level hands-on experience with Checkmarx One (SAST) or equivalent enterprise SAST platforms. ▪ Deep experience with DAST tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or commercial alternatives. ▪ Extensive experience architecting and integrating security tools into Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Azure Dev Ops, or Git Hub Actions at enterprise scale. ▪ Strong expertise in container security, Kubernetes security, and API security. ▪ Hands-on experience designing and implementing secrets management solutions (Hashi Corp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault). ▪ Expert understanding of Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and enterprise vulnerability management practices. ▪ Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native security controls. ▪ Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Cloud Formation, Pulumi, or Ansible. ▪ Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies. ▪ Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk). ▪ Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Go, or Power Shell. ▪ Experience driving security initiatives in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments. ▪ Experience with threat modeling and secure architecture reviews. title: Specialist, Software Technology PLC Programming
jobDescription:
Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Essential

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. PLC Software development.
2. Develop and maintain simulation concepts for PLC-controlled machine functions.
3. Understand and make changes to existing software.
4. Design, program, and modularize PLC applications according to IEC 61131-3.
5. Develop PLC control logic primarily in Structured Text (ST) and Object-Oriented Programming.
6. The technology environment is based on IEC 61131-3, Structured Text, Beckhoff Twin CAT, modular function-block-based PLC logic, fieldbus communication, and machine interfaces.
7. Perform requirements analysis, software design, development, and unit testing.
8. Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan.
9. Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization's development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solutions.
10. Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of LIS product software.
11. Follow KLA defined software development processes.
12. Perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.

title: Product Engineer
jobDescription:
service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. As product engineers we are actively engaged in the Service & NPI continuity processes for the Broadband Plasma systems covering multiple aspects of product development, service readiness, field support & reliability improvements. Serves as the central technical resource / interface with design engineering, manufacturing, technical support, installation, quality, marketing and field as the product(s) move through the Product Life Cycle. Works to optimize serviceability, reduce cost-of-service through all stages of the PLC, and improve short and long term product service revenue performance. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle to ensure system level product performance is continuously tracked and meets established specification . Drives continuous improvement of system hardware, diagnostics and software, tooling, technical documentation, knowledge management, and training. Must be effective in matrixed work environment. Travel may be required. We are looking for candidates who are seeking professional growth and can demonstrate leadership attributes. Job Scope & Responsibilities Strong knowledge of overall system operation, system integration, and system calibrations. Support internal and external customers in the operation, installation, upgrade, diagnosis, repair and application of systems. Act as a two way conduit of information between design teams, and tech support and service personnel. Strong oral and written communication skills. Very adept at 7-step trouble-shooting, including driving learning and standardization where appropriate. Able to step into a difficult beta and sustaining escalation, analyze data from various sources, and, working with divisional experts when necessary, provide a detailed action plan suitable for execution by Customer Service Engineer (CSE) and Technical Support Engineer (TSE). Respond to situations where first-line support has failed to resolve problems by providing written plans of action by e-mail or hands-on assistance at customer sites in the US, Asia, and Europe. Analyze product performance for key contributors to poor performance and work with engineering teams to understand root cause and develop improvement plans. Write technical reports to communicate issues, analysis, technical assessments, system status, and engineering recommendations. Implement and track progress of the NPI/Sustaining work. This will include Diagnostic improvements, software feature requirements development, training plans and documentation planning and contribution. Work closely with Engineering, attending concept and design reviews to provide feedback on serviceability of new designs and potential improvements. Participate in NPI Best Practice teams to spread knowledge across product divisions. Hands-on work for integration of Alpha/Beta systems, including performing serviceability validation. Drive small projects in matrix environment Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Interacts with senior internal and external personnel. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. 25% travel domestic & foreign.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Clean room experience, is preferred. Hands-on experience on semi-conductor equipment Strong Knowledge and hand on experience with Networking, Servers, Unix Operating System. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. As product engineers we are actively engaged in the Service & NPI continuity processes for the Broadband Plasma systems covering multiple aspects of product development, service readiness, field support & reliability improvements. Serves as the central technical resource / interface with design engineering, manufacturing, technical support, installation, quality, marketing and field as the product(s) move through the Product Life Cycle. Works to optimize serviceability, reduce cost-of-service through all stages of the PLC, and improve short and long term product service revenue performance. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle to ensure system level product performance is continuously tracked and meets established specification . Drives continuous improvement of system hardware, diagnostics and software, tooling, technical documentation, knowledge management, and training. Must be effective in matrixed work environment. Support internal and external customers in the operation, installation, upgrade, diagnosis, repair and application of systems. Act as a two way conduit of information between design teams, and tech support and service personnel. Strong oral and written communication skills. Very adept at 7-step trouble-shooting, including driving learning and standardization where appropriate. Able to step into a difficult beta and sustaining escalation, analyze data from various sources, and, working with divisional experts when necessary, provide a detailed action plan suitable for execution by Customer Service Engineer (CSE) and Technical Support Engineer (TSE). Respond to situations where first-line support has failed to resolve problems by providing written plans of action by e-mail or hands-on assistance at customer sites in the US, Asia, and Europe. Write technical reports to communicate issues, analysis, technical assessments, system status, and engineering recommendations. Implement and track progress of the NPI/Sustaining work. This will include Diagnostic improvements, software feature requirements development, training plans and documentation planning and contribution. Work closely with Engineering, attending concept and design reviews to provide feedback on serviceability of new designs and potential improvements. Participate in NPI Best Practice teams to spread knowledge across product divisions. Hands-on work for integration of Alpha/Beta systems, including performing serviceability validation. Drive small projects in matrix environment Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Interacts with senior internal and external personnel. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. 25% travel domestic & foreign.

title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Developement
jobDescription: Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Responsibilities Drive end-to-end development of software features, from requirements analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, and distributed applications using modern software engineering practices. Translate business and system requirements into robust, maintainable, and extensible software solutions. Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, helping shape long-term platform improvements. Write high-quality, production-ready code with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Investigate, analyse, and resolve complex technical issues through effective debugging and root cause analysis. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions and ensure successful feature delivery. Participate in code reviews and support engineering best practices across design, development, testing, and documentation. Support production deployments, customer escalations, and operational activities as needed. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to software quality, development processes, automation, and tooling. Share technical knowledge and support the growth of team members through collaboration and mentoring. About the Role Join a team building software that powers complex, high-performance systems used in demanding production environments. In this role, you will design, develop, and support scalable software solutions while working closely with cross-functional engineering teams. You will have the opportunity to own features end-to-end, solve challenging technical problems, and contribute to the evolution of enterprise-grade software platforms. We are looking for a strong software engineer who combines technical depth, ownership, and collaboration skills to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions that create customer value. Preferred Qualifications Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or scalable platform development. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Dev Ops practices, and automated testing frameworks. Experience with observability, monitoring, and production support tools. Exposure to large-scale data processing, analytics, or data platform technologies. Experience working in environments where software interacts with complex systems, hardware, or infrastructure. Demonstrated ownership of features or subsystems through the complete software development lifecycle. Minimum Qualifications ⁠Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. ⁠5+ years of professional software development experience building and delivering production software systems. Strong proficiency in Java, with working knowledge of Python or similar programming languages. Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design, design patterns, and software architecture principles. Experience developing backend applications using frameworks such as Spring Boot. Hands-on experience building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed applications. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and multithreaded programming. Experience working with relational and/or No SQL databases and designing data-driven applications. Experience developing, deploying, and supporting containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis skills. Experience working on medium-to-large scale software projects with measurable business impact. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global teams. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. title: Manager - Software Development
jobDescription: Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process. KLA's e Beam Division seeking a passionate software Manager to join us and help define and deliver high quality solutions for our current and future generation products in our portfolio. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be responsible to lead teams that build machine control software for our products which would have a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all. Do you consider yourself as a big picture thinker with solid fundamentals of computer science; an innovator with a curiosity about connecting the dots? Someone who loves to lead from the front and is keen on delivering indispensable value to customers? If this sounds like you! We strongly believe you to be a perfect fit for this role. You will lead a team of impactful individuals and work with outstanding talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing You will have the opportunity to learn, design, lead, contribute and collaborate in developing end-to-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about developing individuals and nurture an environment of innovation and customer focus. Having a keen interest and ability to analyze problems and tackle them would be essential in this role. The role would require the following key skills Provide technical leadership and be able to support the detailed analysis and tradeoffs for the various solutions Able to uncover root causes, devise and drive innovative analyses and solve difficult problems that span whole systems or organizations. Drive adoption of Agentic AI to accelerate solution delivery, improve engineering productivity, and embed AI-powered capabilities into core software products to enhance customer experience and reduce time-to-recipe. Lead a medium sized team of 6 to 8 engineers working on different product releases and product domains. Own schedules and outcomes for features assigned to the team. Prior experience in working with Microsoft .Net or C++ programming. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Minimum Qualifications A Master's Degree with 6 years demonstrated ability, or a Bachelor's degree in either Computers or a related Engineering field plus 8 years of confirmed experience is required. An experience of 3 years or more in leading and nurturing teams, scheduling work and delivering to commitments is crucial. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. title: Engineer, Product Applications
jobDescription:
Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Application Development Engineer

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head-to-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world-wide customers. This includes-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating & sharing product value statements and use-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers. Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests. Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution. Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations. Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users. Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams. Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review. Requirements: We are looking for high energy, self-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own. Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields. Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills. title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
jobDescription: Job Description/Preferred Qualifications About the Role We are looking for an AI Engineer to design and develop machine learning, statistical analytics, and agentic AI solutions for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering applications. The role combines software engineering, applied machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and modern AI frameworks to build intelligent systems that improve product performance, defect detection, engineering productivity, and manufacturing insights. The engineer is expected to contribute independently, lead small to medium-sized technical initiatives, and collaborate across software, algorithms, systems, data science, and product teams. Given the product is a large data analytics solution for the semi industry, proficiency in C++ is necessary in addition to python. Key Responsibilities Machine Learning & Statistical Analytics Design and implement machine learning solutions for classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and forecasting. Develop statistical models using: Hypothesis testing Regression analysis Bayesian methods PCA Time-series analysis Design of Experiments (DOE) Predictive analytics Analyze large-scale manufacturing and engineering datasets to derive actionable insights. Evaluate model performance and drive continuous improvements. Deep Learning & Computer Vision Develop deep learning models for: Defect classification Pattern recognition Image segmentation Object detection Feature extraction Build and optimize models using: Py Torch Tensor Flow ONNX Work with image-processing pipelines and semiconductor inspection datasets. Agentic AI & LLM Applications Develop AI assistants and workflow automation solutions using modern agent frameworks. Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources and engineering workflows. Develop tool-using AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, and workflow execution. Contribute to multi-agent systems for engineering productivity and analytics. Software Engineering Design and implement production-quality software in: C++ Python Convert business and system requirements into scalable AI solutions. Develop reusable software libraries, APIs, and services. Participate in code reviews and software design reviews. Optimize performance, scalability, and reliability of AI services. Collaboration & Product Development Work closely with: Software Engineers Algorithm Engineers Product Managers Applications Teams Contribute to solution design discussions. Participate in feasibility studies and technical investigations. Support deployment, validation, and customer adoption activities. Required Qualifications Education Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph D in: Computer Science Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Statistics Mathematics Computer Engineering Related discipline Experience Typically: BS + 5 years experience OR MS + 3 years experience OR Ph D with relevant experience Consistent with the experience expectations for the P3 AI Engineering level. Required Technical Skills Programming Strong proficiency in: Python Modern C++ (C++14/17/20) Experience with: Data structures Algorithms Object-oriented design Multithreaded programming Machine Learning Experience developing and deploying: Random Forests XGBoost Gradient Boosting Isolation Forest Clustering Algorithms Predictive Models Deep Learning Hands-on experience with: Py Torch Tensor Flow Deep Neural Networks CNNs Transformers Vision Models Statistical Analytics Strong understanding of: Probability & Statistics Experimental Design Statistical Inference Feature Engineering Data Validation Model Evaluation Agentic AI Exposure to one or more: Lang Graph Lang Chain Auto Gen Crew AI Semantic Kernel Open AI Agents SDK MCP (Model Context Protocol) Skills include: Tool Calling Workflow Orchestration RAG Systems Knowledge Retrieval AI Automation Preferred Qualifications Semiconductor manufacturing experience. Yield analytics or defect analytics experience. Experience with: Vector databases Knowledge graphs Ray Spark Kubernetes Docker Experience building enterprise AI solutions. What Success Looks Like Within this role, you will: Independently deliver AI and machine-learning features. Design and deploy production-ready statistical and deep learning models. Build agentic AI capabilities that improve engineering productivity. Contribute to image-processing and advanced analytics solutions. Influence architecture and technical design decisions. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices. title: Specialist, Software Technology
jobDescription: Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. KLA's e Beam Division is looking for passionate software developers to join us and help define and deliver high-quality solutions for our current generation and next generation products in our Wafer Inspection and Review product lines. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be responsible to build software solutions for the machine control software of our products which would have a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all. You will fit right in if you have a good understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science. Are you somebody who enjoys working on complex software, is very keen on understanding customer use cases and enjoys, understands the big picture? You will work with exceptional talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing. You will have the opportunity to learn, contribute and collaborate in developing end-to-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on learning and applying clean coding practices. Having a keen interest and ability to analyze problems and tackle them would be critical in this role. Knowledge of Object-Oriented software analysis and design, Microsoft .Net or C++ programming would also be important. Be responsible for the analysis of current software systems for performance, throughput, diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems and comping developing solutions that address these issues. Be responsible for developing prototypes and working on solutions for new concepts. Implement machine control software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions. Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource intensive software requirements to optimize and enhance performance of the hardware system. Good software documentation skills are required. Be willing to learn new design principles, technologies and business use-cases is essential. Equal Employment Opportunity KLA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Collaborate with system, product, and domain experts to define algorithm performance requirements and deliver customer‑driven solutions. title: Senior Data Engineer
jobDescription: service, creativity and technological excellence enables employee productivity, business analytics, and process excellence. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications SAP Data Ingestion & Integration Design and implement robust ingestion patterns from SAP source systems (S/4HANA/ECC/BW/HANA) and other cloud source systems into Snowflake using enterprise-approved integration tools. Build and maintain incremental loads (CDC), batch pipelines, and near-real-time ingestion where needed. Understand SAP functional domains and data structures (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP) to map business requirements to data models. Snowflake Data Engineering & Modeling Develop and optimize ELT/ETL pipelines leveraging Snowflake capabilities (e.g., Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, Dynamic Tables where applicable). Create and maintain curated dimensional and/or data vault models, conformed dimensions, and reusable fact tables for cross-functional analytics. Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls (source-to-target), and exception handling for SAP extracts. Performance, Cost, and Reliability Optimization Tune queries and pipelines for performance using clustering strategies, caching awareness, pruning, warehouse sizing, and workload separation. Monitor and manage Snowflake consumption and performance; recommend cost controls (warehouse scheduling, auto-suspend/auto-resume, resource monitors). Data Governance & Security Apply security best practices: RBAC, masking policies, row access policies, and secure data sharing patterns as needed. Partner with governance teams to maintain metadata, lineage, glossary alignment, and compliance standards. Collaboration & Delivery Collaborate with BI developers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable datasets. Contribute to Agile ceremonies and deliver iterative improvements with high engineering standards. Document pipelines, models, SLAs, and operational runbooks; participate in on-call/production support rotations as required. Required Qualifications 5–7 years of experience in data engineering, with hands-on development in Snowflake. Strong experience integrating SAP data into analytics platforms or data warehouses. Strong SQL skills (advanced joins, window functions, query optimization); experience with performance tuning in cloud warehouses. Experience building production-grade pipelines using one or more of: Orchestration: Informatica, ADF, dbt orchestration, or similar Transformation: dbt, stored procedures, Snowflake SQL scripting, or equivalent Proficiency in Python (or comparable language) for automation, data processing, and pipeline utilities. Understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, normalization, data vault basics). Experience with CI/CD practices (Git, code reviews, deployment pipelines) and environment management (dev/test/prod). Preferred / Nice to Have Palantir Foundry experience (pipeline development, curated datasets, permissions/lineage) and Ontology experience (Objects/relationships). Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA data models and performance concepts (e.g., CDS views, HANA calculation views). Experience with BI/visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and building datasets optimized for reporting/semantic layers. title: Manager, Software Engineering
jobDescription:
Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership: Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for distributed IMC software infrastructure supporting image computing clusters. Team Development: Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers and technical leaders. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product, hardware, and algorithm teams to align infrastructure capabilities with evolving image processing and AI requirements. Platform Architecture: Oversee the design and implementation of scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems optimized for hybrid CPU/GPU workloads. Lifecycle Management: Lead the end-to-end development of image computing platforms, from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance, using best-in-class project management practices. jobDescription:
service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. They provide visualizations, recommendations based on analytics, and alerts. This exciting position will enable you to interact with a wide variety of engineers and KLA system data.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Do you have a passion for coding, data exploration, and UI design? Are you looking for a role where you can develop reactive, modern user interfaces working with highly collaborative teams? As a Software engineer, you will work with our team of software, data and algorithm engineers on the design and development of web applications using real-time data visualization tools. Collaborating with domain experts and software engineers, you will gather requirements, translate user needs to design and develop software specifications, select software components, follow best coding practices, and develop User Interfaces that help our engineers to more effectively monitor, diagnose and optimize KLA semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment. QUALIFICATIONS:

Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures and algorithms) Proficiency in web technologies such as HTML, CSS, Java Script, and libraries/frameworks such as Angular, React, Vue, etc. Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as C#, C++, Java, Python etc. Experience developing clean, efficient, and performant user interfaces Full stack development experience Strong communication skills Desired

The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. This leader will play a critical role in shaping and scaling solutions spanning advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, NLP, large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks. Oversee the development of Generative AI and NLP-based solutions, including applications involving summarization, text mining, sentiment analysis, automation, and LLM-enabled workflows. title: Manager, Software Test Automation
jobDescription:
Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Overview: The PCB division develops and supports two major product lines AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) and AOS (Automated Optical Shaping). These products span multiple generations of technology, including C++ based systems, Java‑based applications, and modern Web UI front‑ends used across different platforms. The SW & SQE Manager will play a key role in establishing and scaling our new India engineering group, ensuring strong quality practices, impactful automation, and tight alignment with global R&D. Mission: Build and lead a hybrid team
- Manual QA, Automation, and SW Dev(second phase) to accelerate quality and delivery for PCB software Key
